title: Epical Optimized+PVP
description: Optimization for PVP in Low end device
body:
The ultimate performance engine meets competitive precision.
Tired of losing fights to frame drops? Epical Optimized + PVP is a meticulously curated, lightweight modpack designed to push your FPS to the absolute limit while giving you the cleanest, most responsive PvP experience possible. Built on top of the fastest optimization mods available, this pack strips away the engine bloat and replaces it with competitive-grade enhancements.
⚡ Key Features
🚀 Maximum FPS & Smoothness
Next-Gen Optimization: Powered by Sodium, Lithium, and a suite of modern performance engines to maximize frame rates and eliminate micro-stutters.
Fast Loading & Low Memory: Optimized RAM usage and ultra-fast world/server loading times, perfect for lower-end PCs or squeezing every Hz out of a high-refresh-rate monitor.
⚔️ Competitive PVP Enhancements
Fluid Animations & Physics: Enhanced combat animations and particle controls so you can track your targets with flawless clarity.
HUD & UI Clarity: Clean, customizable PvP heads-up displays, status effect timers, and keystroke overlays without the clutter.
Optimized Network Performance: Tweaks designed to reduce input lag and improve server packet handling, ensuring your hits register exactly when they should.
🎨 Visuals & Quality of Life
Built-in Shader Support: Features Iris Shaders, allowing you to switch to beautiful visuals when you're just building, and instantly toggle them off for zero-latency combat.
Dynamic Zoom & Gamma: Essential competitive tools like cinematic zoom and full-bright adjustments built right in
